title: Master Internship in AI for biological microscopy
about: Inria's OPIS team in Gif-sur-Yvette, France, offers a Master internship in AI for biological microscopy (offer 2026-10564). Applications are made through the Inria jobs portal; the deadline to apply is 28 February 2027.

upskill.name: the AI Foundations Academy page
why: No course reached course_min_score with a genuine match (record lists no requirements; top shortlist scores were 4 on generic "AI" terms), so the post links to the AI Foundations Academy page.
field "Artificial intelligence, biological microscopy" → AI Foundations Academy, which includes Computer Vision I ("Image segmentation: semantic, instance, panoptic (Mask R-CNN, SAM)").

card_alt: Card for the Master Internship in AI for biological microscopy at Inria (OPIS team), Gif-sur-Yvette, France, deadline 28 Feb 2027. The photo shows the Eiffel Tower and the Trocadéro in Paris with La Défense behind, not Gif-sur-Yvette.
